name: Currents Saver
description: Save the article you are reading to your own Currents server. Never sees your password.
// permissions: activeTab + scripting: read the DOI and the publisher's citation_pdf_url from the page you are
looking at, and ONLY when you click the toolbar button. There is no content script running
in the background on any site.
storage: remembers your server address. Nothing else is stored.
host_permissions <all_urls>: the PDF is fetched from whichever publisher you are reading, and
there is no fixed list of those. The extension still only acts on an explicit click.
